_comment: The six playable creatures. `cell` is the picture's number in vendor/opengameart/tiny-creatures.png — 16x16 cells, 10 across, 18 down, so cell n sits at x = (n % 10) * 16, y = floor(n / 10) * 16. All six are real, friendly animals: no dragons, no demons, no merfolk. The `element` is flavour only — in a duel you choose fire, water or earth yourself each round, so your animal does not decide anything (decision-log row 52).
